question: Does the retained h=4 common-cover structure necessarily force a nonzero genus-preserving first-order deformation of the Q602 image curve, contradicting the exact equigeneric isolation proved in EX1-05R?

parent_05r.exact_use: For every r=0..28, the conductor/adjoint equigeneric tangent target H^0(D,omega_D tensor phi^*omega_Q^{-1}) is zero because its degree is -162+2r<0. Any required low-genus image is equigenerically isolated.

parent_05n.exact_use: For phi=(f105,f81):D->C2xC2, Tor(N_phi) has length tau=deg gcd(R105,R81), 0<=tau<=2r; the saturated normal line bundle has degree -162+2r-tau<0, hence H^0(N_phi)=H^0(Tor(N_phi)) and h0(N_phi)=tau.

parent_05o.exact_use: The relative V4 cover is finite etale and contributes no local ramification inertia or source-bound continuous deformation direction; its retained content is discrete/global torsor data.

dedieu_sernesi.title: Equigeneric and equisingular families of curves on surfaces
dedieu_sernesi.locator: Lemma 2.2(ii) together with the normal-sheaf torsion decomposition in Section 2
dedieu_sernesi.exact_use: For a family of maps from smooth curves to a fixed smooth surface, with central map birational onto its image, the inverse image in the base tangent space of H^0(H_phi), the torsion part of the normal sheaf, lies in the kernel of the differential to the Hilbert/curve-space image. Thus a torsion first-order map deformation does not move the image curve to first order.

setup.common_v4_condition: f105^*Z ~= f81^*Z for fixed finite-etale H=(Z/2)^2 cover Z->C2

normal_sheaf_decomposition.torsion: H_phi=Tor(N_phi), supported exactly where both projection differentials vanish

image_deformation_map.map: first-order fixed-target map deformations -> first-order deformations of the scheme-theoretic image curve in Curves_Q^xi
image_deformation_map.dedieu_sernesi_kernel: H^0(H_phi) maps to zero image tangent
image_deformation_map.consequence: Because every section of H^0(N_phi) is torsion, every first-order deformation of phi is killed by the image-deformation differential.
image_deformation_map.consistent_with_05r: The Cartesian equigeneric reduced tangent cone is already zero; the parametric common-cover calculation supplies no hidden nonzero direction.

decision.reopen_condition: Only reopen if a source-bound common-cover deformation is exhibited whose first-order image tangent is nonzero after quotienting the normal-sheaf torsion, contradicting the proven vanishing of H^0(Nbar_phi).

next_route.selection_reason: 05R proves any target image is equigenerically isolated, and 05S proves the common-cover map deformation cannot supply a nonzero image tangent because all available normal-sheaf sections are torsion and vanish under the image map. The remaining non-reconstruction route must attack existence of the isolated superabundant point itself.
